getting-started.title: Getting Started
actions: Install: `cargo install guestkit` or release binary
Optional: `guestctl tui vm.qcow2` or GHCR compose → `:8088`
getting-started.empty: Missing qemu-img/NBD → install qemu-utils; permission denied → sudo or `modprobe nbd`
getting-started.success: Doctor prints 0–100 score + blockers; `guestkit version` works

quick-reference.title: Quick Reference
quick-reference.empty: No OS found → check filesystems; wrong format → detect/info
quick-reference.success: Inspect shows OS/hostname; doctor score present

cli-guide.title: CLI Guide
actions: Inspect group: inspect, filesystems, packages, network
Assurance: doctor, migrate-plan, passport, policy, fleet
cli-guide.empty: Unknown subcommand → `guestkit commands`; feature-gated cmds need `--features agent|ai|mcp`
cli-guide.success: Help lists groups; sample inspect returns text/JSON

interactive-mode.title: Interactive Mode
interactive-mode.empty: `ls /etc` empty usually means unmounted — run `mount`; launch fail → NBD/loop/permissions
interactive-mode.success: Welcome shows detected OS; packages/users return lists

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.how: `guestkit inspect IMAGE` · TUI Overview · web Image Vault
inspect.empty: No OS → encrypted/corrupt/empty disk; use filesystems + interactive mount

filesystems.title: Filesystems
filesystems.empty: Empty partition list → wrong image / need NBD; LUKS needs cryptsetup

packages.title: Packages
packages.empty: Empty = no package DB / Windows guest / mount failed

services-users.title: Services & Users
services-users.how: `guestkit systemd-services IMAGE`; users via REPL/inspect; TUI
actions: Users: interactive → `users`, or inspect User Accounts
services-users.empty: Non-systemd OS → sparse services; Windows users via registry inspect
services-users.success: Enabled units listed; users show uid/shell

network.title: Network Inspect
network.empty: No ifaces → cloud-init-only / netplan not parsed

files.title: Guest Files
actions: Multi-step: `interactive` or `explore`; backup: `guestkit backup IMAGE -o out.tar.gz`
files.empty: Path missing → wrong mount/root; permission → sudo/NBD

guest-control-fabric.title: Guest Control Fabric
guest-control-fabric.how: Web/API via zyvor-api KubeVirt guest routes
guest-control-fabric.empty: `console_only`/`blind_vm` → install QGA/agent or stop VM for offline path

guest-agent.title: Guest Agent
guest-agent.how: Build `--features agent`; inject offline; proxy on host
guest-agent.empty: No channel → missing virtio-serial/QGA; Windows needs virtio-serial driver

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.how: `guestkit doctor IMAGE` · TUI Assurance `d` · web Passport
doctor.empty: Low score + blockers until repaired; mount failures abort

migrate-plan.title: Migration Plan
migrate-plan.success: Migration score + checklist; YAML plan if exported

migration-assurance.title: Migration Assurance
migration-assurance.empty: Verify fails below threshold → repair then re-emit; BitLocker hard-block
migration-assurance.success: Passport verify exit 0; doctor score acceptable for target

fix-plans.title: Fix Plans
actions: `plan export` to bash/ansible; `plan rollback` if needed
fix-plans.success: Preview lists ops; apply reports success; doctor improves

repair.title: Repair
repair.empty: Dry-run only = no disk change; NTFS dirty → ntfsfix first
repair.success: Doctor score rises; rescue op applied

policy.title: Policy Gate
actions: Gate pipelines on non-zero / `--strict`; pair with passport verify
policy.empty: Missing policy file; expressions fail if evidence fields absent
policy.success: Pass/fail per rule; JSON report written

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.success: Clusters/snowflakes/blockers; waves; watch reports drift or clean

forensic-diff.title: Forensic Diff
forensic-diff.empty: Identical images → low drift; mount fail on either side

profiles.title: Profiles
actions: Inspect profiles: security, migration, performance, compliance, hardening, windows-migration
Automate over fleet with shell loop

export-formats.title: Export Formats
export-formats.how: `--output` vs `--export` on inspect; plan export; passport JSON
actions: TUI view export / web Passport download

kubevirt-integration.title: KubeVirt Integration
kubevirt-integration.how: zyvor-api HTTP + CLI offline on PVC path
actions: Install agent via guest/install-agent or vmtools
kubevirt-integration.empty: Running VM → offline inspect skipped; missing PVC path

zeus-vm-tools.title: Zeus VM Tools
zeus-vm-tools.empty: Coverage 0 → QGA down / no network → use qga file bootstrap
zeus-vm-tools.success: Agent connected; coverage chip; freeze/thaw works

tui.title: TUI (guestctl)
actions: `{`/`}` groups; Tab views; Ctrl+P jump; `:` palette
tui.empty: Blank panes → inspect failed (permissions/format); check footer
tui.success: Dashboard populated; doctor score on Assurance

python-bindings.title: Python Bindings
python-bindings.empty: Import error → wrong package/feature; launch fail → NBD/sudo

vm-migration.title: VM Migration Guide
vm-migration.empty: Boot fail post-cutover → fstab/GRUB/VirtIO; never write while guest running
vm-migration.success: Doctor high enough; passport verifies; first boot on target

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
actions: Container: privileged + `/dev/nbd*`; gather version + uname + lsmod
troubleshooting.empty: Persistent device busy → disconnect all nbd / reboot
troubleshooting.success: Same failing command succeeds after fix

faq.title: FAQ
actions: Passport vs virt-v2v: certify then convert
Cache under `~/.cache/guestkit/`; escalate with version + repro
faq.empty: N/A (doc); point to troubleshooting for runtime
faq.success: Reader can run cited command successfully
